mode: independent parent source reading, no execution
findings: Normals use central or one-sided mesh finite differences; motion is along vertex normal, not tangential opacity averaging.
Binary prediction >0 sampled at rounded nearest voxels across +-15 L0 normal offsets by default; closest run centre is selected, followed by local parabolic adjustment.
Offset field uses 5x5 median jump rejection >6 vox, normalized Gaussian fill, sigma1 smoothing and +-15 clipping. This does not guarantee physical layer identity or uniqueness.
A vertex with no predicted run can still move due to neighboring offset fill; only unsupported neighborhoods retain the fitted position. Header no-sheet summary is less precise than implementation.
Arguments z0/z1 are parsed but not used. Passing a z band will not bound reads or computation.
Sampling gathers all valid mesh vertices before processing; cropped/local use needs explicit restricted mesh or bounded Zarr acquisition with verified complete support.
Three adjacent original windings are processed independently; no inter-winding separation/duplicate prevention is implemented.
The method reads structural surface predictions and never uses ink output. Predictions still need original CT verification.
